_what: Music generators for route 2, read by composer.py generated record and check. status: whitelist (may ship case by case: consent first, terms snapshot, a passing blind bake-off), held (temp only until a named question is answered), temp_only (open weights untested), excluded (temp only at most; never shipped), excluded_always (never used).
_read: 2026-10-27, each vendor's own terms, from lab record lab-00018 (not shipped) Terms changed about once a quarter through 2025–26: re-read before each shipped track, and snapshot the page.

elevenlabs.allows: paid plans: 'All online and offline commercial use permitted, except film, TV, radio, and Studio Games'
conditions: no mimicking a recording artist's voice
Free–Pro are 'For Individual Use Only' ('Individual' undefined)
film, TV and radio need Enterprise Music
elevenlabs.controls: section lengths in ms, instrumental flag, inpainting, native stems, video-to-music, 48 kHz PCM, C2PA signing

stable_audio.allows: every plan incl. Free: 'Commercial advertisements, podcasts, and client projects'; 'You own your outputs'
conditions: indemnity only under the Enterprise licence
stable_audio.controls: exact lengths (to ~6:20), inpainting a time range; licensed training data (AudioSparx + screened Freesound)
stable_audio.source: [PRIMARY · Stability KB, Stable Audio commercial and usage licensing; stableaudio.com/pricing · checked 2026-10-27]
